sn35.155:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.155:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante dhammakathiko hotīti.
sn35.155:2.1: cakkhussa ce bhikkhave bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti dhammakathiko bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya.
sn35.155:2.2: cakkhussa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti dhammānudhammapaṭipanno bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya.
sn35.155:2.3: cakkhussa ce bhikkhu nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto hoti diṭṭhadhammanibbānapatto bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya …pe…
sn35.155:2.4: jivhāya ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti dhammakathiko bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya …pe…
sn35.155:2.5: manassa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti dhammakathiko bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya.
sn35.155:2.6: manassa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti dhammānudhammapaṭipanno bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya.
sn35.155:2.7: manassa ce bhikkhu nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto hoti diṭṭhadhammanibbānapatto bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāyāti.
sn35.155:4.1: tatiyapaṇṇāsake vaggassuddānaṃ yogakkhemi ca loko ca
